rule: X — The Hollows through the year
texts: Whenever a sky-cat hunts on the Cliff Path, the lanterns at the Hollows produce many threads.
In deep winter the lanterns at the Hollows produce a small thread harvest.
In spring the lanterns at the Hollows produce a steady thread harvest.
In summer the lanterns at the Hollows produce a steady thread harvest.

fields.sentence: Whenever a sky-cat hunts on the Cliff Path, the lanterns at the Hollows produce many threads.
parse: (: lo80_rule (Implication (And (Member $x hunt) (Agent $x $sc) (Member $sc sky_cat) (Location $x cliff_path)) (And (Member (sk_produce $x) produce) (Agent (sk_produce $x) sk_lantern_1) (Patient (sk_produce $x) (sk_thread $x)) (GroupOf (sk_thread $x) thread) (CardinalityPhrase (sk_thread $x) "many") (During (sk_produce $x) $x))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q2_gaps: a definite plural group as the subject of a whenever-rule consequent: a distributive predicate on a group normally also requires a per-member PartOf distribution rule, but the instruction set gives that rule no place inside an Implication's conclusion, so each lantern's own producing event is unreachable

"many" as a vague count on an object NP: it appears only in the proportion-to-strength table (many -> 0.7, for quantification over a subject kind) and is absent from the CardinalityPhrase vague-quantity list, so which channel an object-position "many Ns" takes is left unstated
review.notes: The whenever machinery is applied correctly — indefinite trigger participant as a plain premise variable with its typing conjunct, per-occurrence Skolem consequent, During link, no QuantifierPhrase companion, 1.0/0.9 — as are the Cliff Path name-plus-kind atoms and the Name-only treatment of the capitalized plural label "the Hollows" (no GroupOf, no invented kind). Location for event-side "on" and LocatedIn for entity-side "at" are both the licensed heads.

fields.sentence: In deep winter the lanterns at the Hollows produce a small thread harvest.

q2_gaps: A multi-word, non-deictic time expression ('in deep winter') filling a Time slot: the Time section lists structured terms (Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute) and bare deictic/named constants, and the compound-concepts rules are stated for predicates/classes/properties/actions, so whether the fused constant deep_winter takes a decomposition genus (as the compound condition room_temperature does) or stays opaque is unaddressed.
review.notes: Transitive 'produce' correctly keeps Agent on the inanimate lantern group and Patient on the created harvest, the classifier 'thread harvest' fuses with its head genus while the descriptive 'small' stays a separate Member atom, and the group-as-unit reading with no per-member rule is the instruction set's default for a singular shared product.

fields.sentence: In spring the lanterns at the Hollows produce a steady thread harvest.

q2_gaps: a bare, non-deictic season as a time value ("in spring") — the `Time` term inventory is Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute plus bare day-part symbols, and seasons are mentioned only as deictic constants ("last_spring", "next_summer")

a seasonal frame on a habitual present with no explicit "every" — the named-slot-implies-its-cycle rule (`Every e 1 <cycle>`) is stated only for "every X" wording, so whether a cycle atom is owed here is unspecified
review.notes: "the Hollows" is correctly a `Name`-only individual with no `GroupOf` and no per-member kind, per the capitalized-plural-label rule; the definite plural subject correctly takes a group witness with entity-attached `LocatedIn` for "at". The group predicate is treated as collective (group event, no per-member distribution rule), which the shared singular object supports but which the instruction set leaves to the parser's distributive/collective judgment.

fields.sentence: In summer the lanterns at the Hollows produce a steady thread harvest.

q2_gaps: a bare, non-deictic season as a time slot ('in summer'): the structured Time terms are Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute only, and the bare-symbol licence covers speech-anchored deictics (last_spring, next_summer) and day-parts, neither of which reaches a plain season
review.notes: The bare simple present correctly gets no status atom (the habitual/dispositional default), 'steady' stays a separate Member atom as incidental description while 'thread harvest' fuses with its head genus and unexposed noun modifier, and Patient is right for a creation verb. 'the Hollows' again takes the plural-label Name-only treatment.
